Fields.Name: On Event
Fields.Description: The event that blends this in. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Off Event
Fields.Description: The event that blends this out. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: How much this layer counts (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Bone Weights
Fields.Description: Per-bone weights for this layer. None: every bone has weight 1.

Fields.Name: Fade In Duration
Fields.Description: How long the layer takes to blend in, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Fade Out Duration
Fields.Description: How long the layer takes to blend out, in seconds.

Fields.Name: On By Default
Fields.Description: Whether the layer is on when the layer generator activates.

Fields.Name: Use Motion
Fields.Description: Whether this layer's root motion counts.

Fields.Name: Force Full Fade Durations
Fields.Description: Whether a fade always takes its full duration, even when it starts part-way.
